row: Dr. Michael White is the Chiropractor and owner of Chiropractic and Rehabilitation of Miami Lakes. He has over 17 years of clinical experience in the field of Chiropractic. Dr. White also has worked extensively with patients using physiotherapy, physical therapy, and other rehabilitative treatment to resolve injuries. This channel is an educational platform for Dr. White to share his knowledge with the public.
